ticks.note: Entering A initialises its local c to 10, then runs the entry action: c = 11. x = 0.
The self-loop copies c into x (x = 11) and re-enters A, which sets c back to 10 and adds 1 again.
x = 11 again, not 12: a state's local variables are re-initialised every time the state is entered, also by a self-loop.
